choices: A function defined in a subclass
A function that takes functions as arguments or returns a function
A function with more than 3 parameters
explanation: Higher-order functions treat functions as first-class values. In Java, methods that accept Function<T,R>, Predicate<T>, or Consumer<T> are higher-order. Stream methods like map(Function) and filter(Predicate) are examples. This enables composable, reusable pipelines without imperative loops.
